inputs.name: ReportStorageSyncService.constructor.repository
inputs.description: The ReportRepository dependency used to load reports and resolve report directories. Defaults to new ReportRepository(); a supplied repository replaces that default.

inputs.name: ReportStorageSyncService.run.options
inputs.description: Optional selector and flag for a sync pass: run selects one report ID, while dryRun prevents storage writes. Defaults to {}; when run is absent, all reports are listed, and an absent dryRun behaves as false.

outputs.name: ReportStorageSyncService.run
outputs.type: Promise<{ reports: string[]; evidence: number; replays: number; skipped: number; errors: string[]; dryRun: boolean; }>
outputs.description: Summarizes report IDs with at least one pending evidence file or eligible replay, aggregate file counts, retention skips, per-report error messages, and the effective dryRun flag. evidence counts distinct pending evidence filenames; replays counts hash-named .mp4 files without storage receipts.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error from repository.get(options.run) or repository.list() can reject run before its per-report error handling begins. Failures during an individual report sync are caught and added to the returned errors array.
